Card.Name: Lock Screen Background Motion
Card.Description: Some devices can show a subtle motion effect on the lock-screen background. This policy decides whether that motion is prevented.
Card.FriendlyDescription: Some devices can show a subtle motion effect on the lock-screen background. This policy decides whether that motion is prevented.
